en: Shihab al-Din Ahmad ibn Abd al-Wahhab al-Nuwairi
ar: شهاب الدين أحمد بن عبد الوهاب النويري

description.tr: 31 ciltlik Nihâyetü'l-Ereb, en kapsamlı Arapça ansiklopedilerden biridir || Nüveyrî tüm bilgiyi beş fenne böldü: gök ve meteoroloji, insan, hayvanlar, bitkiler ve tarih. || [Tarih notu] Tarih bölümleri, Moğol istilâları ve Haçlı seferlerini artık kayıp olan Memlük kaynaklarından korur.
description.en: His 31-volume Nihayat al-Arab is one of the most comprehensive Arabic encyclopaedias — a vast synthesis of Islamic knowledge organized into five 'arts' || al-Nuwairi organized all knowledge into five funun: sky and meteorology, man, animals, plants, and history. His method anticipated later European encyclopaedic classification. || [Historiographical note] His history sections preserve accounts of the Mongol invasions and Crusades from Mamluk sources now lost.
description.ar: موسوعته ذات الواحد والثلاثين مجلداً من أشمل الموسوعات العربية || نظم النويري المعرفة كلها في خمسة فنون
